Bridge a cut
============
1. Press 'Grab the cut'. It takes BOTH frames either side of the nearest cut —
   the last frame of the outgoing clip and the first of the incoming one.
2. Wire the two images into your first/last-frame video model.
3. Run. The clip lands back in the gap it came from.

'place at (seconds)' is captured when you press the button, so the result goes
back to THAT gap even if you move the playhead afterwards. It is already wired
into Send to Resolve, which is set to 'at a time'.

Needs two clips back to back on the SAME video track.

Models needed — LTX 2.5 (any first/last-frame model works)
------------------------------------------------------------
All from  https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5

diffusion_models/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors   21.5 GB
text_encoders/gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors           15.4 GB
loras/ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-lora-450-bf16.safetensors                                8.9 GB
vae/ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors                                          1.5 GB
vae/ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors                                               0.4 GB
latent_upscale_models/ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors        1.0 GB

Where they go
-------------
ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/   ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/
ComfyUI/models/loras/              ComfyUI/models/vae/
ComfyUI/models/latent_upscale_models/

Run the distilled LoRA at strength 1.0. Keep the filenames as they are.
at the cut it came from

Your first/last-frame video model goes HERE
-------------------------------------------
first frame -> start image
last frame  -> end image

Then wire its VIDEO output into Send to Resolve's 'video' input.
